newsitem.title: USA: PacificAmerica stake cut by group.
newsitem.headline: PacificAmerica stake cut by group.

text.p: A group including Kramer Spellman L.P., a Fort Lee, N.J., investment firm, said Tuesday it reduced its stake in PacificAmerica Money Center to 6.99 percent, or 126,200 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it most recently sold a net 20,000 shares of PacificAmerica. It did not specify how much it received for the shares.
The group previously held a 9.02 percent stake in PacificAmerica.
